name: Plexamp, Now Playing
description: Album cover, album and artist for one Plexamp player (e.g. a headless Plexamp), read from Plex /status/sessions. When nothing is playing, shows a random album from your music library, stable per time bucket so battery panels don't repaint every wake.

settings.name: plex_token
settings.label: Plex token
settings.help: Server owner's X-Plex-Token (needed to see all sessions)

cell_options.name: layout
cell_options.label: Layout
cell_options.help: Cover-first layouts for grid dashboards. On a Panels canvas, the Part picker overrides this.

choices.label: Gallery: whole cover, small lines above/below
Overlay: cover fills the panel, small caption bottom-right

cell_options.name: player
cell_options.label: Player name contains
cell_options.help: Matched against the Plexamp player's title / product / machine id. Blank = any music session.

cell_options.name: include_paused
cell_options.label: Keep showing the album while paused

cell_options.name: show_track
cell_options.label: Show track title
cell_options.help: Off = one repaint per album. On = one repaint per song (more battery).

cell_options.name: shelf_hours
cell_options.label: Random cover changes every N hours

cell_options.name: section
cell_options.label: Music library (name or id, blank = all)

choices.label: Colour (let the panel palette dither it)

fragments.label: Gallery: whole cover, small lines above/below
Overlay: cover fills the panel, small caption bottom-right
